name: drawer
title: Drawer
description: Full-height side panel built on the native dialog element, sliding in from the right or left.

props.name: title
props.description: Drawer title, also used for aria-labelledby.

props.name: side
props.description: Side of the screen the drawer appears from.

props.name: trigger
props.description: Element that opens the drawer when clicked.

props.name: footer
props.description: Action area. Wrapped in form method=dialog, so a type=submit button closes the drawer.

props.name: id
props.description: Dialog id. Use it to open the drawer from elsewhere with showModal().

props.name: closeLabel
props.description: Accessible label of the close button.

a11y: Uses dialog with showModal(), so focus stays inside and the page behind is inert.
Escape closes the drawer and returns focus to the trigger.
Clicking outside the panel (the backdrop) closes the drawer.
The close button is labelled by closeLabel.

ai.whenToUse: A side panel for filters, item details, or a longer form without leaving the page.
rules: Footer buttons that should close the drawer must be type=submit
Use Modal for short confirmations, not Drawer
Never open a drawer inside another drawer

id.description: Panel samping setinggi layar berbasis elemen dialog native, muncul dari kanan atau kiri.

props.title: Judul drawer, dipakai juga sebagai aria-labelledby.
props.trigger: Elemen yang membuka drawer saat diklik.
props.footer: Area aksi. Dibungkus form method=dialog, jadi tombol type=submit menutup drawer.
props.id: Id dialog. Bisa dipakai untuk membuka drawer dari luar lewat showModal().
props.closeLabel: Label aksesibel tombol tutup. Isi "Tutup" untuk situs berbahasa Indonesia.

a11y: Memakai dialog dan showModal(), jadi fokus terkunci di dalam drawer dan konten di belakangnya inert.
Escape menutup drawer dan fokus kembali ke elemen pemicu.
Klik di luar panel (backdrop) menutup drawer.
Tombol tutup punya aria-label dari closeLabel (default Close).

ai.whenToUse: Panel samping untuk filter, detail item, atau form yang lebih panjang tanpa meninggalkan halaman.
rules: Tombol di footer yang harus menutup drawer wajib type=submit
Untuk konfirmasi singkat gunakan Modal, bukan Drawer
Jangan membuka drawer di dalam drawer
